scope: Chemistry within NT6: LB 1, 2.1 and 2.3; hydropower is included as the required context of 2.1. This is not a complete NT6 course.
tracks: The official NT6 page is shared; separate R/M NT tracks start in Grade 7.
hours_note: The fetched official sections state no hour allocations.

neighbours.boundary: Revisits states, mixtures and separation from NT5 4.1/4.2; builds on nt-mittelschule-5 without transferring its cards.
Air composition and extended atom models belong to NT7 2.1/2.2 and are not taught as NT6 content.
Air composition and extended atom models belong to NT7 2.1/2.2 and are not taught as NT6 content.

rows.competence: führen angeleitet Untersuchungen zu naturwissenschaftlichen Fragestellungen durch, notieren ihre Beobachtungen und ziehen einfache Schlussfolgerungen.
rows.evidence: The app trains a fair comparison, reading an authored measurement series and separating observation from inference. Actual investigations and an original protocol must be completed in class.

rows.competence: verwenden einfache Geräte und Materialien sachgerecht.
rows.evidence: The lesson explains thermometer, stopwatch and beaker roles, safe handling and damaged equipment. Learners must demonstrate actual equipment handling under classroom supervision.

rows.competence: erläutern fragengeleitet durch den Vergleich eines einfachen Modells mit der Realität Möglichkeiten und Grenzen eines Modells.
rows.evidence: Learners compare labelled particle and molecule schematics with reality and explain the limits of model colour, size, spacing and selected relationships in written transfer tasks.

rows.competence: planen angeleitet Untersuchungen in verschiedenen Sozialformen und protokollieren einfache Arbeitsabläufe und Ergebnisse.
rows.evidence: The package provides a research question, controlled-variable comparison, measurement table and protocol structure. Group planning, real execution and an original investigation record remain classroom work.

rows.competence: veranschaulichen weitgehend angeleitet einfache naturwissenschaftliche Sachverhalte.
rows.evidence: A labelled measurement diagram, molecule-counting model and food-web/substance-cycle model support changing between descriptions, pictures and diagrams in the two authored task levels.

rows.competence: wählen themenbezogene und aussagekräftige Informationen aus vorgegebenen Quellen aus.
rows.evidence: Learners are guided to select relevant, attributable evidence from provided sources; the app offers a verified official curriculum link. A comparative multi-source research exercise remains in class.

rows.competence: verwenden bewusst naturwissenschaftliche Fachbegriffe, um einfache Sachverhalte angemessen zu beschreiben.
rows.evidence: Quick checks, classification and two written tasks per lesson require terms including observation, inference, phase transition, molecule, element and compound in distinct contexts.

rows.competence: wägen Folgen des persönlichen Handelns für sich und die Umwelt ab.
rows.evidence: Transfer tasks weigh consequences of cleaning products in ponds, changes to waterways and schoolyard sealing, with concrete benefits, effects and reasoned alternatives.

rows.competence: nutzen Fachwissen, um Risiken bei einfachen Experimenten und in Alltagssituationen einzuschätzen und grundlegende Sicherheitsmaßnahmen zu ergreifen.
rows.evidence: Label reading, risk judgement and stopping/reporting an incident are taught explicitly. Real conduct and the required experiment-specific safety briefing must be checked by the supervising teacher.

rows.competence: zeigen an Beispielen die Bedeutung von Wasser für das Leben auf der Erde auf.
rows.evidence: The labelled life/food/transport model and tasks distinguish water as habitat, food and transport medium and challenge the claim that clear water is safe drinking water.

rows.competence: charakterisieren Wasser anhand experimentell ermittelter Stoffeigenschaften.
rows.evidence: Worked findings cover state, melting and boiling points with pressure conditions, solubility, qualitative conductivity and surface tension. Experimental measurement of actual samples remains supervised classroom work.

rows.competence: verwenden das Kugelteilchenmodell zur Erklärung der Aggregatzustände des Wassers und deren Übergänge.
rows.evidence: The temperature-controlled particle model distinguishes solid, liquid and gas, treats phase-boundary coexistence, and supports the four changes, evaporation below boiling and invisible vapour versus visible droplets.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Anomalie des Wassers und erklären deren Bedeutung an ausgewählten Beispielen.
rows.evidence: Equal-mass volume comparison, the density maximum near 4 °C, floating ice, a deep winter lake and frost splitting are explained, with explicit limits for shallow ponds and unsafe ice conclusions.

rows.competence: nutzen Modelle zur Darstellung des Baus von Molekülen und bezeichnen diese mit der chemischen Formelsprache.
rows.evidence: Labelled H/O models let learners count the atoms of water, hydrogen and oxygen molecules and distinguish an element, compound and molecule. Tasks read H₂O, H₂ and O₂ and critique model colours.

rows.competence: weisen die bei der elektrolytischen Zersetzung von Wasser entstehenden Gase experimentell nach und charakterisieren die Elemente Wasserstoff und Sauerstoff.
rows.evidence: The model conserves four H and two O atoms and illustrates the 2 : 1 equal-condition gas-volume ratio. Given observations of the two gas tests are interpreted; actual electrolysis and gas detection remain supervised classroom experiments.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Bedeutung und Nutzung von Wasser als erneuerbare Energiequelle, indem sie die Energieumwandlung im Wasserkraftwerk erklären.
rows.evidence: The labelled hydropower model follows potential, motion, turbine and generator energy and evaluates renewability against fish migration and residual flow. This is the explicit cross-disciplinary context within NT6 2.1.

rows.competence: erläutern ein Nahrungsnetz im Ökosystem Wald und stellen einen Stoffkreislauf dar, um die Wechselwirkungen zwischen Erzeugern, Verbrauchern und Zersetzern zu veranschaulichen.
rows.evidence: The forest model connects leaves, caterpillars, aphids, tits and sparrowhawk into a network, defines the direction of food arrows and returns matter through decomposers and mineral uptake while distinguishing energy flow.

rows.competence: erläutern die Bedeutung der grünen Pflanzen als Produzenten anhand der vereinfachten Fotosynthesegleichung.
rows.evidence: The lesson teaches only the simplified word equation, separates input substances from light energy and products, and uses plant/soil misconceptions in the transfer task; no advanced molecular reaction balancing is required.

rows.competence: beschreiben Boden als Ort natürlicher Zersetzung und bestimmen einige Lebewesen in Streu und Oberboden.
rows.evidence: The package explains breakdown and mineral availability and practises distinguishing an earthworm, adult mite and adult woodlouse from labelled body/leg features. Finding and identifying real organisms in litter and topsoil remains classroom work.

rows.competence: erläutern Bodenfunktionen und begründen daraus Maßnahmen zum Bodenschutz.
rows.evidence: A four-layer schematic explains habitat, water storage and limited filtration. Learners assess sealing, compaction, plant cover and pollutant avoidance through worked examples and schoolyard design tasks.

excluded.reason: Aquatic organism identification, microscopy, fish adaptation and the aquatic food web are the biological perspective and outside this Chemistry package.
Puberty and prenatal development belong to the biological/health perspective.
Forces, mechanical work and motion belong to the physics perspective.
